package otel

import "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/attribute"

var (
	AttributeMatch       = attribute.Key("flipt.match")
	AttributeFlag        = attribute.Key("flipt.flag")
	AttributeFlagEnabled = attribute.Key("flipt.flag_enabled")
	AttributeSegment     = attribute.Key("flipt.segment")
	AttributeReason      = attribute.Key("flipt.reason")
	AttributeValue       = attribute.Key("flipt.value")
	AttributeEntityID    = attribute.Key("flipt.entity_id")
	AttributeRequestID   = attribute.Key("flipt.request_id")
)

#   memory:
#     eviction_interval: 5m # Evict Expired Items Every 5m

# server:
#   protocol: http
#   host: 0.0.0.0
#   https_port: 443
#   http_port: 8080
#   grpc_port: 9000

# db:
#   url: file:/var/opt/flipt/flipt.db
#   max_idle_conn: 2
#   max_open_conn: 0 # unlimited
#   conn_max_lifetime: 0 # unlimited

# tracing:
#   jaeger:
#     enabled: false
#     host: localhost
#     port: 6831

# meta:
#   check_for_updates: true

cache:
  enabled: true
  backend: memory
  ttl: 60s
  memory:
    eviction_interval: 5m # Evict Expired Items Every 5m

server:
  protocol: https
  host: 127.0.0.1
  http_port: 8081
  https_port: 8080
  grpc_port: 9001
  cert_file: "./testdata/ssl_cert.pem"
  cert_key: "./testdata/ssl_key.pem"

tracing:
  jaeger:
    enabled: true

db:
  url: postgres://postgres@localhost:5432/flipt?sslmode=disable
  max_idle_conn: 10
  max_open_conn: 50
  conn_max_lifetime: 30m

meta:
  check_for_updates: false
  telemetry_enabled: false

authentication:
  required: true
  session:
    domain: "auth.flipt.io"
    secure: true
    csrf:
      key: "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz1234567890" #gitleaks:allow
  methods:
    token:
      enabled: true
      cleanup:
         interval: 2h
         grace_period: 48h
    oidc:
      enabled: true
      providers:
        google:
          issuer_url: "http://accounts.google.com"
          client_id: "abcdefg"
          client_secret: "bcdefgh"
if cfg.Tracing.Jaeger.Enabled {
jaeger.WithAgentHost(cfg.Tracing.Jaeger.Host),
jaeger.WithAgentPort(strconv.FormatInt(int64(cfg.Tracing.Jaeger.Port), 10)),
Jaeger: JaegerTracingConfig{
Jaeger: JaegerTracingConfig{
// JaegerTracingConfig contains fields, which configure specifically
// Jaeger span and tracing output destination.
type JaegerTracingConfig struct {
Jaeger JaegerTracingConfig `json:"jaeger,omitempty" mapstructure:"jaeger"`
stringToCacheBackend = map[string]CacheBackend{
stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToCacheBackend),

var decodeHooks = mapstructure.ComposeDecodeHookFunc(
	mapstructure.StringToTimeDurationHookFunc(),
	stringToSliceHookFunc(),
	stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToLogEncoding),
	stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToCacheBackend),
	stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToScheme),
	stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToDatabaseProtocol),
	stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToAuthMethod),
)
Tracing        TracingConfig        `json:"tracing,omitempty" mapstructure:"tracing"`
tracing:
// Jaeger span and tracing output destination.
// TracingConfig contains fields, which configure tracing telemetry
v.SetDefault("tracing", map[string]any{

cert_key: "./testdata/ssl_key.pem"

tracing:
  jaeger:
    enabled: true

db:
  url: postgres://postgres@localhost:5432/flipt?sslmode=disable
  max_idle_conn: 10
  max_open_conn: 50
  conn_max_lifetime: 30m

meta:
  check_for_updates: false
  telemetry_enabled: false
path: "./testdata/advanced.yml",

selection.summary: Unified tracing configuration implemented following the existing cache migration pattern: tracing.go now defines top-level tracing.enabled and tracing.backend fields with jaeger.enabled deprecated and automatically migrated to the unified fields (mirroring cache.memory.enabled -> cache.enabled/cache.backend, per h0/h12); a deprecation warning is emitted for tracing.jaeger.enabled (h2); stringToTracingBackend registered in decodeHooks (h1/h31); grpc.go enables Jaeger tracing via cfg.Tracing.Enabled && cfg.Tracing.Backend == TracingJaeger instead of legacy cfg.Tracing.Jaeger.Enabled (h6); advanced.yml test fixture uses legacy config to exercise the migration path (h29), with its test expectation at h27 to be updated to the unified fields.

native_export.selection_posture: Explicit terminal handles plus at most one presented, provenance-valid adjacent test read for a selected same-stem implementation source; native source projection and export unchanged.

sidecar.claim_ceiling: Confirmed delivery and declared final selection only; neither proves semantic use.

source_projection.claim_ceiling: Only exact unchanged source lines map to base coordinates. Changed/inserted lines receive no base-context credit.
